ui.leave_a_tab_ungrouped_if_its_best_sco: Leave a tab ungrouped if its best score is lower. Higher is more conservative; Chat scores are self-ratings, not accuracy.
ui.the_best_candidate_must_lead_the_alte: The best candidate must lead the alternatives, including no match, by this margin. Otherwise the tab stays ungrouped.
ui.caps_proposals_when_creation_is_allow: Caps proposals when creation is allowed. It is not a target and does not relax the 3-page minimum.
ui.truncates_both_local_and_remote_page_: Truncates both local and remote page content. Larger values preserve more context and may increase model input costs.
ui.limits_page_and_candidate_input_per_r: Limits page and candidate input per request in UTF-8 bytes, not tokens. Too small a budget can trim content or fail to fit candidates.
